body: Drake @champagnepapi has fans guessing after teasing “FOMO” for September 15 👀🤔 Could it be an album, a tour announcement or a new single? According to the , there’s a 52% chance of a new Drake album before December 1, 2026. Drake previously used “Fear Of Missing Out” in a July 2025 Instagram post tagging NOCTA and Nike, but it’s still unclear what the September 15 reveal will bring. He is currently on pace for the biggest streaming year ever for a rapper, another album could push those numbers even higher and make an already massive year even bigger 🤯🔥 What do you think “FOMO” will turn out to be? 👀 #KalshiPartner
